_what: Which test files wait until after the merge (27 Nov 2026, the owner's Open Loops row 'West Peek OS: merge check under 5 minutes': 'Fast checks before merge, long tests on main after, with a time limit'). Read by scripts/ci/shard-tests.mjs. The PR lane runs every test file EXCEPT after_merge; an after_merge file still runs on a PR that changes it or a file it imports directly, and every file runs when the PR touches tests/helpers, tests/fixtures, this file, vitest/TS config or the lock. The FULL lane (every push to main, nightly, on demand; the deploy waits on it) runs all of them. A pr_always file is a private-data, money, send or authority guard and can never be listed after_merge (validate:shards fails). An after_merge entry is a long end-to-end flow whose guards are held before the merge by a named validator or a pr_always file; its value says which.
